items.html: Now we should provide the reason that both the light of Yesod and Malchut rose up to Daat, above Tifferet. The reason is, etc., that since the conduct of Yesod is to rise to the Daat, hence, now the light of Yesod ascended to Daat, above Tifferet, as well as in order to connect all the VAK together and bring them illumination from there.
